rationale: PostgreSQL with native FTS (GIN index on simple tsvector) and pgvector (HNSW index on vector(1024)) satisfies all 8 quality gates: Recall@10 = 1.0 (>=0.90), nDCG@10 = 0.9978 (>=0.85), 100% citation identity, 100% exact negative recall, 100% semantic warning recall, 0.0% isolation leakage, warm p95 = 231.33ms (<=1000ms) at 22.55 QPS over 10,060 documents, and 0 external inference calls. Under task rules ("Choose existing PG when both pass without justified operational gain"), PostgreSQL is selected as the sole production backend. This eliminates the operational overhead, extra daemon, memory footprint, and separate snapshot/backup lifecycle of Qdrant.

features: Native PostgreSQL simple FTS with GIN index on spaced CJK / alphanumeric tsvector
pgvector 0.3.6 with HNSW cosine distance index (embedding vector_cosine_ops, m=16, ef_construction=64)
Parameterized SQL CTE Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60) with pre-retrieval ACL/as-of index filtering
Row Level Security (RLS) support for strict tenant/persona/workspace isolation
postgres_pgvector.operational_overhead: Zero additional daemons; runs inside existing PostgreSQL infrastructure.

features: Dense vector collection with cosine distance
qdrant.operational_overhead: Requires separate daemon, extra TCP port (6333), dedicated memory allocation, and independent volume snapshot/backup regime.
qdrant.justification_for_rejection: PG satisfies all quality and latency gates with 0.0% leakage and 231ms p95. No >=30% CPU/p95 benefit demonstrated that would justify running a secondary database daemon.

readiness_probe.db_probe_sql: SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname="vector"

rebuild_procedure.method: Execute services/search/sql/retrieval_index.sql against database; re-index versioned projections via SearchIndexPipeline or PostgresRetrievalBackend.index_documents
rebuild_procedure.idempotency: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE

rollback_procedure.method: SearchGateway facade maintains backwards-compatible search(), index_documents(), and delete_document() signatures. If Postgres is unavailable, gateway returns structured degraded/unavailable error.
